order: one marker-only JFR control and full marker/oracle validation
three independent native JFR + LogCompilation recordings
offline export after all recordings finish
extraJvmOptions: LogCompilation options only in three profile forks
requirements: Control must have 34 successful, non-overlapping, continuous markers in exact original catalog order; exact query text/parameters and all 14-field oracle signatures
Do not retry a failed recording as acceptance or infer gains from elapsed time
Input JAR hashes and full real 64-graph inventory before/after
Full recordings: preserve all events and unmatched/crossing compiler intervals; keep ExecutionSample distinct from CPU time and other thread types
No new optimization/CI run or gate threshold changes
limits: Benchmark wrapper/class initialization, custom JFR markers, native JFR and compilation logging may perturb execution
Query duration markers exclude queueing, serialization, metric collection and marker preparation/commit; do not equate them to TSV end-to-end latency
Outer windows do not alone prove initial/provenance phase boundaries
Compilation logs have coarser clock resolution; retain separate timelines unless independently matched by compilation identity
